company.name: PlaysOut
company.shortDescription: PlaysOut is a mini-game platform that helps developers publish mini-games on superAPP platforms
company.description: PlaysOut is a gaming infrastructure company that develops tools and platforms for embedding mini-games into mobile apps, messaging platforms, and super apps. The company provides a software development kit (SDK) and runtime system that allows developers and platform operators to distribute lightweight games across multiple environments without requiring separate app downloads. Its platform supports cross-platform game deployment, analytics, monetization, and optional Web3 features such as token-based rewards and digital asset integration. PlaysOut works with game developers, app platforms, and entertainment companies to support user engagement through embedded interactive content.
